name: Both gates
blurb: Open ground, both gates, and a ball that does not pay.
aside: The treats are what make a walk of this length fit. The stick at A1 is the top of column A, so only one line picks it up, and that line crosses the water and then the cave. It scores −11. A walk through the stick at D3 still finishes and scores −12. The ball at C10 is a longer walk that also reaches the flag, and it scores −12.
